actual_request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game animation frame.
Asset: exactly ONE newly drawn full-body frame, original character 04_mountain_guardian_boy, SOUTHWEST walk frame 03 of a 16-frame cycle. One character on one square canvas; no grid or repeated figures.

Reference roles:
1. Original full portrait: lock the original character identity, face, costume, materials, palette and equipment.
2. Magenta-background two-pose SOUTHWEST reference: the LEFT figure is existing SW01, shield-side leg planted forward. Its RIGHT figure is SW13 and is not the requested phase.
3. Transparent-background two-pose SOUTHWEST reference: the RIGHT figure is existing SW05 with staff-side leg raised. Its LEFT figure is SW09 and is not the requested phase.
Use the same SOUTHWEST camera as references 2 and 3. Do not reproduce their two-column layout. Draw a genuinely new intermediate transition from SW01 toward SW05; do not copy either endpoint.

Direction and identity: facing diagonally DOWN-LEFT, front three-quarter view. Huge round head, tiny stocky body, warm brown eyes, short brown loose front hair and high brown ponytail, pale green ribbons, small gold forehead mark, wooden bead necklace, ivory and ochre cloud-trim clothing, green braided belt and gold buckle, short puffy ivory trousers, brown/gold boots with green braided ankle ties. The character's anatomical RIGHT hand holds the upright ring-headed staff on screen LEFT; anatomical LEFT arm carries the green/gold round shield on screen RIGHT, with its single near-side gold shoulder pauldron. Retain these sides, exact ornaments, staff and shield identity.

Pose SW03: the SHIELD-SIDE LEFT leg at screen RIGHT remains the planted support leg, its whole boot on the low ground line. The STAFF-SIDE RIGHT leg at screen LEFT is now halfway through rising toward SW05: bend the right knee forward beneath the left edge of the robe, lift that entire right boot clearly above its prior low position but only HALF as high as in the SW05 endpoint. The swing sole tilts slightly toward the viewer as it travels down-left. This is the halfway phase from SW01 to SW05, not a standing pose or full high knee. Exactly two legs and boots; no ghost of the prior boot. Never exchange the support and swing legs.

Keep the same head-to-body ratio, anatomical scale, camera distance, clothing volume and equipment proportions. Allow only small natural gait bob, cloth response and ribbon motion. Keep the staff tip and tassels above the planted foot baseline. Keep the entire silhouette, ponytail, ribbons, staff and shield inside the frame with at least 5% clear margins, centered horizontally. No detached effects or ground shadow.

Highest available native visual fidelity: request a native 2048x2048 single-frame square image with crisp hand-painted contour detail, clear eyes, braid, fabric trim, boots and metal carving. Do not upscale a small reference, add pixel texture, sharpen halos or invent extra ornament. The full native single-person cell must be at least 1024 pixels on both axes; actual delivered native dimensions will be verified separately.

Background: perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF magenta. Foreground fully opaque with clean natural antialiased edges. No semitransparent ghost boots, duplicate outlines, magenta leaking through clothing, checkerboard, labels, captions, borders, divider, watermark or extra figures.
